name: Fried stink bugs
summary: Stink bugs soaked, seasoned, and fried until golden, with lime leaf on the plate. After cooking the smell is gone, and what remains is the fried bug and a light lime-leaf fragrance.
origin: Vietnamnet, 16 March 2019. Thái and Muong households in Sơn La.
howToEat: From the plate, with lime leaf. The season is longan blossom and fruit set. An hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Longan gardens in the province. A city stall was not named.
seoTitle: Bo xit rang in Son La — fried stink bugs
seoDescription: Bọ xít rang in Sơn La, in longan season. Vietnamnet soaks them in salt water and sour-bamboo water, then fries them with lime leaf.
